opening.argument: The presentation connects OneCoin participation directly to earning money and promotes starter packages beginning at 30 €. It then places a claim of 625,000 USD per month alongside that earnings question, presenting recruitment-based income as an attractive opportunity. The closing promotional graphic points to a person who sponsored more than 400 first-line recruits and invites viewers to request his “secret strategy.” Together, the paid entry packages, prominent monthly earnings claim, and invitation to learn how to sponsor a large first line support a tiered recruitment-commission income structure.

citations.quote: How can you earn money using onecoin?
